comments: Follow-up to kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_oracle_damp_kernel3_finetune_dropout.json's ceiling result (val dice 0.4821, decisively beating plain max-pool's 0.3757) and the alpha=4/5 CFAR results (0.3357/0.3749 -- alpha=5's higher precision beat alpha=4's higher recall). A precision/recall sweep over CFAR alpha (measured directly against ground truth, per-target connected-component recall + pixel precision, sampled 120 real targets) showed alpha=5 only reaches 3.4% pixel precision at 92.5% target recall, while alpha=7 reaches 25.3% precision at 80.0% recall -- a much steeper precision gain than recall loss, following the same direction that already won once (alpha=5 > alpha=4). ref_cells=1, guard_cells=1 (unchanged). Testing whether pushing further toward oracle's implicit ~100% precision (at the cost of recall) continues to help, or whether alpha=5-7 is near the real-detector optimum before recall loss dominates.
